arms.description: Show the source-formatted article excerpt about growth in Apple iPhone market share
Show the source-formatted article excerpt about growth in the U.S. Hispanic population

reference_arm_rationale: The source independently randomizes an attention-matched iPhone-growth article as the control topic. The benchmark retains both article policies and does not invent a no-message arm.

nuisance_factor.standardization_rule: Average every article arm equally over the 16 programmed recipient names. This preserves the planned 50/50 White-name versus Black-name factor and the uniform 1/8 implementation distribution within each name-race level.

outcome_question: Below, please indicate how much money you would like to give the randomly named person you have been paired with.
decision_maker: a public-interest communicator choosing which one of the two fielded informational article policies to place before an anonymous giving opportunity
beneficiary: anonymous recipients under the narrow objective of increasing the amount transferred to them
utility_rationale: Higher Q4 directly transfers more of a real $10 endowment to the paired recipient. This is a recipient-transfer utility, not a claim that demographic threat, induced anxiety, or either article improves general social welfare.
truthfulness_scope: The exact historical article screenshots are reconstructed as fielded. Any new deployment would require independent verification of every factual and source-attribution claim and must not imply current Wall Street Journal publication or endorsement.
target_population: U.S. adults identifying as White or Black/African American represented by the study-specific post-stratification weight
weighting_rule: Within each article-by-name cell, compute the Hajek weighted mean using positive finite source weight; average the 16 cell means equally within article arm. Report the unstandardized weighted article-arm mean and the four-cell XTESS187 estimator as prespecified sensitivities.
missingness_rule: Exclude source refusal code -1 from Q4; accept only whole-dollar values 0 through 10; never infer missingness from outcome distributions.
primary_estimator: Normalize valid Q4 as Q4/10. Compute a source-weighted Hajek mean within each of the 32 article-by-name cells, then average the 16 name-cell means with frozen weight 1/16 for each article. Subtract the iPhone-control mean from the Hispanic-growth mean.
sensitivity_estimators: study-weighted Hajek mean normalized donation by article arm without name standardization
study-weighted four-cell XTESS187 means, reported without turning the randomized recipient-name factor into four competing policy arms
unweighted equal-name standardized mean normalized donation
bootstrap_procedure: Resample participants with replacement within each of the 32 randomized article-by-name cells, retain the source weight, recompute all cell means and the equal-name standardized arm means, winner, and regret using the canonical benchmark seed after split freeze.
socsci210_reconstruction_note: SocSci210 exposes only later identity and threat tasks 1 through 5 and collapses XTESS187 to the article-prime factor. It omits source Q4 donation and the recipient-name factor. No SocSci response may substitute for Q4, and the primary human score must come from the original source data after split assignment and recommendation freeze.
checkpoint_compatibility: The released Socrates participant_mapping.json lists pb2rr as seen. Never describe a released Socrates checkpoint evaluation on this task as experiment-held-out.
reconstruction_note: The complete 12-page final questionnaire and both one-page fielded PDF stimuli were rendered and visually verified. The mixed archive was not newly downloaded. Its already-local participant SAV was extracted to a temporary directory, read first at zero rows for labels, then read only for XTESS187, DOV_INSERT_NAME, and weight to verify 781 rows, positive weights, all 32 article-by-name cells, and pre-outcome support. Q4 was not projected or opened; no outcome missingness, distribution, arm statistic, effect, significance result, or winner was computed. The temporary SAV was deleted after mapping.
